Name: Laborious Flight
Description: Up to three creatures you choose within range are granted the ability to fly through ethereal arcane wings that sprout from their backs for the spell's duration, though using them is difficult. These creatures gain a belabored flying speed of 20 feet. Additionally, if any creature targeted by this spell already has a belabored flying speed, that speed becomes its normal flying speed for the duration (this new flying speed does not gain extra speed from this spell).
At Higher Levels:
When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can choose one of the following effects for each slot level above 2nd:
● The belabored flying speed granted by this spell increases by 10 feet.
● You can target one additional creature within range.
● The spell's duration is doubled.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
